description: The read-only viewer, its three new breakdown components, and the app-shell wiring. Depends on FEAT-001 (imports deriveSheetTotals, section-visibility, view-route, share-codec, share-validate, combat-stat-block helpers). Builds the SharedCharacterViewer (decode -> loading/error/sheet; reuses calculators via deriveSheetTotals + the *BreakdownContent tooltip pattern; open-panel for snapshots; separate explicit import button), adds WoundsBreakdownContent/WeaponDamageBreakdownContent/MoveBreakdownContent, a useViewRoute hook, and wires App.tsx to intercept #view/ before the shell and skip startup migrations in view mode.
steps: Create src/components/pages/WoundsBreakdownContent.tsx (+.module.css): renders a GIVEN WoundMaxResult (lines SB, TB x2, WPB, Hardy, Total from the result's sb/tb/wpb/hardy/total fields); does NOT re-call computeWoundMaximum. Cite calculators.ts calculateWoundsCore.

Create src/components/pages/WeaponDamageBreakdownContent.tsx (+.module.css): renders the {num,breakdown} from calcWeaponDamage — show breakdown verbatim and append `= {num}` composed by the component; when num===null render the weapon's raw damage string with no derived tooltip.

Create src/components/pages/MoveBreakdownContent.tsx (+.module.css): renders stored move.{m,w,r}; label `Walk = 2xM ({w})` ONLY when w===2*m and `Run = 4xM ({r})` ONLY when r===4*m, otherwise show the stored value labelled 'as recorded on the sheet'; never override the stored value. Cite Core p.164 (Walk=2xM, Run=4xM).

Create src/hooks/useViewRoute.ts: subscribe to hashchange and return parseViewRoute(window.location.hash) (payload or null). Prefer useSyncExternalStore to avoid a setState-in-effect; if an effect is genuinely required the sanctioned Tooltip.tsx eslint-disable pattern may be reused.

Create src/components/shared/SharedCharacterViewer.tsx (+.module.css) taking encoded:string. Bare #view/#view/ -> an 'Open a shared character' panel (Paste textarea + <input type=file accept='.json,application/json'> via FileReader); payload present -> decodeSharePayload then validateSharedPayload. Both entry points funnel through validateSharedPayload (apply MAX_JSON_CHARS pre-check to pasted/opened text first). States: loading (link async path only), error (graceful mapped messages per the design error table + 'Back to my characters' affordance via history.replaceState + synthetic hashchange), sheet. For the sheet compute deriveSheetTotals(character) once and thread it through every total and every *BreakdownContent. Render sections gated by shouldRenderSection with the identical SectionKey values (including the 'Spells and Prayers' section from character.spells and the Ammunition section); always render identity/characteristics/skills/talents/weapons/armour. Every calculated total uses TooltipTriggerCell + a single Tooltip (one open at a time, BreakdownTooltipState-style union). Render portrait only when isValidPortraitDataUrl. Add a footer 'Import into my characters' button opening the viewer's OWN ConfirmDialog; on confirm call importFromJSONWithPortrait(json) (create-new semantics — do NOT reuse SettingsPage's overwrite handler). Import NO editable inputs, NO update/storage/appendEvent.

Edit src/App.tsx — (1) In App(): compute isViewMode = parseViewRoute(window.location.hash) !== null; in the init effect skip runMigration()+getPortraitStore().init()+runPortraitMigration() in view mode (set migrated true directly); add a module-level leftViewMode flag so the 'Back to my characters' transition re-runs the normal init branch once before the shell renders. (2) In AppContent(): before the welcome/shell branch read useViewRoute(); when non-null render ONLY <SharedCharacterViewer encoded={payload} /> (no Navigation/WelcomeScreen/AppWithCharacter/PrintLayout/quick actions). No other behavior altered.

Add tests: src/components/shared/__tests__/SharedCharacterViewer.test.tsx — totals equal deriveSheetTotals(fixture) (incl. unworn-armour + non-default-house-rule fixtures); each total wrapped in TooltipTriggerCell and activating opens a Tooltip whose body is the matching *BreakdownContent (single-open-at-a-time); movement tooltip source-stating with conditional 2xM/4xM labels; container.querySelectorAll('input,textarea,select') empty and spies on localStorage.setItem/getPortraitStore().savePortrait/appendEvent show no calls on render or tooltip; malformed/oversized/newer-version payloads render the mapped message with no throw; 'Import into my characters' touches storage only after confirm and calls importFromJSONWithPortrait once (mocked). src/__tests__/App.view-mode.test.tsx — (1) mounting App on #view/... in a clean env performs no localStorage.setItem and no IndexedDB open/init; (2) fresh #view/... -> Back -> create character initialises the shell and persists the created character.
acceptance_criteria: The #view/ route renders SharedCharacterViewer with zero saved characters and does not fall through to the welcome screen (AC4).

Mounting App on a #view/... hash in a clean environment performs no localStorage.setItem and no IndexedDB open/init (AC1/AC4); the viewer contains no input/textarea/select and performs no writes during render or tooltip interaction (AC1).

Every calculated total in the viewer equals deriveSheetTotals(fixture) for the fixture and exposes a breakdown tooltip via TooltipTriggerCell whose contents come from the matching *BreakdownContent (AC2/AC3); movement shows a source-stating tooltip with conditional 2xM/4xM labels.
Malformed, oversized, and newer-than-CURRENT_VERSION payloads render a clear graceful message with no thrown error / no partial corrupt render (AC11).
'Import into my characters' adds a character only after explicit confirm via importFromJSONWithPortrait (create-new), never on mere viewing (AC12).
verification: vitest --run  (new viewer + App view-mode tests pass; all existing tests still green)
npx eslint .  (0 errors, no new warnings)
findings:
The read-only GM viewer + its breakdown components + app-shell view-mode wiring landed. What FEAT-003 (the share/export UI that produces the links/snapshots the viewer consumes) can rely on:

- src/components/shared/SharedCharacterViewer.tsx (+.module.css): takes `encoded: string`. Bare/empty payload -> 'Open a shared character' panel (paste textarea + <input type=file accept='.json,application/json'> via FileReader); non-empty -> decodeSharePayload -> validateSharedPayload -> deriveSheetTotals(character) computed ONCE and threaded through every total. Entry text paths apply a MAX_JSON_CHARS pre-check. Read-only: NO editable inputs in the sheet (test asserts container.querySelectorAll('input,textarea,select') is empty), NO storage/portrait/appendEvent writes on render or tooltip. The ONLY write is the footer 'Import into my characters' button -> its OWN ConfirmDialog -> importFromJSONWithPortrait(JSON.stringify(character)) (create-new; NOT SettingsPage's overwrite handler). Error states map decode codes (too-large/bad-version/bad-base64url/empty/bad-gzip/bad-utf8) + the validator's version message to friendly text with a 'Back to my characters' affordance. The link FEAT-003 builds MUST encode the FULL validated character JSON (same shape exportToJSON emits); the viewer re-validates every payload, so FEAT-003 can reuse trimForLink(character) (portrait:''+eventLog:[]) for the LINK variant and keep both for the snapshot. Portrait renders only when isValidPortraitDataUrl.
- New breakdown components (src/components/pages/, each +.module.css): WoundsBreakdownContent (renders a GIVEN WoundMaxResult's sb/tb/wpb/hardy/total — never recomputes), WeaponDamageBreakdownContent (renders {num,breakdown} from calcWeaponDamage and composes `= {num}` itself; when num===null shows the raw damage string, no derived tooltip), MoveBreakdownContent (stored m/w/r; labels 'Walk = 2×M' only when w===2*m and 'Run = 4×M' only when r===4*m per Core p.164, else source-states 'as recorded on the sheet' and never overrides). These are reusable by FEAT-003 if it previews totals.
- src/hooks/useViewRoute.ts: subscribes to hashchange via useSyncExternalStore (NO setState-in-effect) and returns parseViewRoute(window.location.hash) (payload string or null). App() and AppContent() both consume it.
- src/App.tsx wiring: App() computes isViewMode = useViewRoute() !== null and SKIPS runMigration()+getPortraitStore().init()+runPortraitMigration() in view mode (sets migrated true directly). A module-level `leftViewMode` flag makes the 'Back to my characters' transition (viewer calls history.replaceState to clear the hash + dispatches a synthetic hashchange via goBackToMyCharacters) re-run the real migration branch exactly once before the shell renders. AppContent() reads useViewRoute() BEFORE the welcome/shell branch; when non-null it renders ONLY <SharedCharacterViewer encoded={payload}/> (no Navigation/WelcomeScreen/AppWithCharacter/PrintLayout/quick actions), so a view link works with zero saved characters (AC4).
- The sanctioned `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` (mirroring Tooltip.tsx) was used ONCE in SharedCharacterViewer's decode effect for the synchronous transient-state reset that syncs viewer state to the external `encoded` prop; the async decode's post-await setStates are not flagged.

Tests added: src/components/shared/__tests__/SharedCharacterViewer.test.tsx (14 tests — totals equal deriveSheetTotals incl. unworn-armour + non-default rangedDamageSBMode fixtures; single-open-at-a-time tooltips wired to the matching *BreakdownContent; movement conditional 2×M/4×M vs source-stating; no inputs + no setItem/savePortrait/appendEvent/import on render or tooltip; malformed/oversized/newer-version payloads render mapped messages with no throw; import only after confirm, importFromJSONWithPortrait called once) and src/__tests__/App.view-mode.test.tsx (2 tests — clean #view/ mount does NO localStorage.setItem and NO indexedDB.open; fresh #view/ -> Back -> Quick Start -> Create Character persists the created character). The viewer test uses vi.hoisted for the import/savePortrait spies and keeps the real importFromJSON intact (the validate pipeline depends on it). The App test imports 'fake-indexeddb/auto' so indexedDB exists to spy on.

Verification run from d:\Git\PWACharSheet, all clean: `npx tsc --build --force --noEmit` (0 errors); `npm run build` (tsc + vite build succeeded, regenerated sw.js, built in ~706ms); `vitest --run` full suite 5283 passed / 481 files, 0 failed (was 5267/479 after FEAT-001; +16 new tests, +2 files); `npx eslint .` 0 errors, 3 warnings (the pre-existing react-refresh/only-export-components warnings in CommandPaletteContext.tsx, CombatPage.tsx, SettingsPage.tsx — untouched by this feature).
